execution.method: independent source-level witness audit followed by a verifier-owned three-order by three-repetition normalization gate

frozen Step 0026 intent, manifest, contract and adversarial cases
R1 and R2 oracle contracts and the R1 public receipt
the eleven manifest-bound R2 Go oracle suites and their mirrored prompts

forbidden_actions_respected: no candidate production file was read, executed or modified
no contract, oracle, prompt, adversarial case or manifest was modified
no seal was emitted because the required discriminatory conditions failed

positive_controls.reason: All seven set-like fields are now checked sequentially, and an unchanged request is checked concurrently, but the required reordered pair is not itself started concurrently.

Retry and terminal no-op coverage improved, but the suites still do not persist/read after every confirmed transition; one unit fixture also expects GetRun success for terminal records with an incomplete required artifact matrix, conflicting with the frozen integrity rule.
The combined suites exercise repeatability, changed page size, ordered continuation and use of the same cursor after reopen with the same secret.
The integrated queue/L4 suites distinguish queued cancellation, RUNNING to CANCELLING, worker acknowledgement, duplicate cancel stability and absence of target execution after queued cancellation.

All three legacy routes are invoked and the first-three schemas/search golden are immutable, but successful benchmark bytes have no frozen golden and recommendation expectation still calls the same candidate serialization helper used by the response.

survivor_groups.reason: The ID sample does not reject derivation from every user-controlled field; interrupted retry is absent; invalid-value/type coverage is not exhaustive for nested fields and every operation; quota rejection is not integrated with Start while counting every identity/executor/durable effect.

No witness covers republish restricted to terminal records, artifact-publication CAS losers, every stage/progress mismatch, real provider-stage cancellation boundaries, result-artifact publication in the terminal race, real-store recovery of every lifecycle/progress, blocked recovery before request acceptance, shutdown plus lifecycle reopen, actual PENDING readability, orphans at authoritative locations, or confirmed-index versus orphan-blob authority. The worker cancellation test's alleged later call is guarded by ctx.Err()==nil after <-ctx.Done(), so that branch is unreachable.

There is no failure injection before each terminal artifact, exhaustive required-artifact matrix, constant-time comparison witness, valid-MAC out-of-range/version/hash cursor mutation, per-component symlink/hardlink coverage, atomic create/transition/blob crash-prefix harness, total-quota overshoot proof with reopen, or create-time eviction scenario. Top-level files named as crash prefixes do not exercise the store's real pending/temp/rename locations or persistence boundaries.

Privacy scans omit several forbidden sources/logs and complete artifact traversal; executor-error terminal sanitization is absent; closed JSON checks contain nested-text assertions that inspect re-escaped response.Result rather than decoding its text; AST audits cover only fixed filenames and shallow call names; legacy benchmark/recommendation comparisons remain incomplete/self-referential; the shared fake proves wiring object identity but not delegation inside the real RecommendationService; non-regular/permission variants are partial; missing get/cancel is tested only through a spy and does not prove no durable materialization.

unknown_policy_audit.negative_unknown_treatment: Any absent or ambiguous negative witness is SURVIVED, never Violated.

stability_audit.reason: TestStep0026R2OfflineDiscriminatoryGateStableThreeByThree maps a negative to Violated solely when its ID has a nonempty binding. It executes neither the named test nor the attack/mutant, so it proves map cardinality and deterministic lookup, not discriminatory stability.

findings: The private L4 helper was replaced by an exported factory, resolving the exact R1 unexported-helper finding.

TestStep0026R2ExternalIdentifiersNeverBecomePathComponents explicitly recognizes cursor-secret and idempotency-index filenames, thereby freezing private physical store names despite those names not being observable contract API.

The legacy test has immutable hashes and literal tool schemas/search bytes, but successful benchmark output has no byte golden and recommendation expected bytes are produced by usecase.MarshalRecommendationResult from the same candidate build.

blocking_findings: 36 valid negative mutations retain concrete surviving variants
P01, P02 and P05 are not completely demonstrated

seal.reason: A seal is forbidden until P01-P05 are Preserved, M01-M60 are independently Violated, the executable 3x3 gate is non-tautological, private details are not frozen and mutation_score equals 1.0.
